title: Widen the decision record: source, decidedBy, scope, adrs, supersedes, plus rejected and withdrawn (seq 179c)
description:
opum-doc seq 179, item (c), relayed by opum-agent. Design: opum-doc docs/reference/questions-decisions-and-adrs.md at main.

The decision record grows the fields the design names -- source, decidedBy, scope, adrs and supersedes -- and the statuses rejected and withdrawn. Today the record cannot express who ruled, what a ruling binds, or what it supersedes, which is why opum-doc built a separate grants/*.json store (QCLI-335).

Existing records must keep reading as they do now; a widened record that makes an old one unreadable is not the change.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The decision record carries source, decidedBy, scope, adrs and supersedes, settable and readable through the CLI
rejected and withdrawn are reachable statuses for a decision
A decision record written before these fields existed still reads correctly
The fields appear in the machine contract and the human rendering
(from QCLI-335) The record can express what a ruling explicitly excludes, not only what it binds, or the design states why scope alone suffices
(from QCLI-335) The design states what it does NOT borrow from opum-doc grants/schema.json and why (expiry and revocation are a poor fit for a ruling record)
(from QCLI-335) The new shape is judged against opum-agent's signal of zero decisions recorded despite frequent rulings, i.e. that it is easier to use, not only more complete

implementationNotes: QCLI-538: QCLI-335 closed as superseded by this task. Its criteria 1 (who ruled, scope, supersedes), 3 (manifest/help) and 4 (backfill stance) are covered by criteria 1, 4 and 3 here. Its criteria 1 (excludes), 2 (grants non-borrow) and 5 (opum-agent zero-decisions signal) had no counterpart and were added here as criteria 5-7.

RULING, ODOC-607 (2026-11-18T22:45:04Z): settled, dispatch. No excludes field (scope plus outcome text carries it); expiry and revocation are not borrowed from grants; easier to use is judged by opum-doc using it.

IMPLEMENTED AC1-AC4, 2026-11-18, on branch feat/QCLI-447-decision-record. Design: opum-doc questions-decisions-and-adrs.md. The record gains optional source (question id, request id, or delegated), decidedBy (operator or opum-doc), scope (cross-repo or component:<repo>), adrs and supersedes; statuses rejected and withdrawn are added. Fields are omitted on write when not supplied, so pre-QCLI-447 records read unchanged - verified both by fixture and against the eight real DEC records (DEC-1..DEC-8 keep exactly their five keys). Manifest fields and the human rendering carry the widened set, and --adr/--supersedes are repeatable. AC5-AC7 are the ODOC-607 rulings (no excludes field; nothing borrowed from grants; ease judged by opum-doc using the tool), recorded not engineered. Verification: typecheck, lint, layer:check and format:check green; 5 new tests plus the affected suites green under bun 1.4.4; the QCLI-411 bun check fails under local bun 1.3.14 and passes under /opt/homebrew/bin/bun 1.4.4, both results recorded.
